name: Identity Stack / Wordmark–Typography Hierarchy Composition Audit
bounded_question: Can exact C0 Threshold K, exact O3 Balanced Hierarchy and TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder coexist inside the already-compatible MAT F1 + STA F2 scaffold across app-compact, website-header and acquisition/prelude roles without mark/name/type hierarchy collision, over-branding restrained app chrome, O3 becoming a second heading, typography competing with the name carrier, or compact Æ failure?
controlled_inputs: exact C0 Threshold K geometry, currentColor only
exact O3 Balanced Hierarchy geometry, currentColor only
TYP-02 F1 Ratio Ladder role grammar with system-ui/Segoe UI measurement carrier
MAT-01 F1 Subtractive Channel support topology
STA-01 F2 Ring + Edge Witness support state grammar
synthetic APP_COMPACT, WEB_HEADER and ACQUISITION_PRELUDE roles

scored_variant.definition: Exact C0 + exact O3 + TYP-02 F1 + MAT F1 + STA F2.

diagnostic_variants.definition: Replace only TYP-02 F1 role values with the TYP-02 CNEG neutral role vector; exact C0/O3/MAT/STA and layout remain.
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Detect whether F1 Ratio Ladder competes with or improves the identity stack.

diagnostic_variants.definition: Hide only C0 while preserving the C0 slot where applicable; exact O3/TYP F1/MAT/STA remain.
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Detect whether C0 is required or whether mark/name competition weakens FULL.

diagnostic_variants.definition: Hide only O3 while preserving its allocated identity measure; exact C0/TYP F1/MAT/STA remain.
diagnostic_variants.purpose: Detect whether the temporary wordmark creates hierarchy collision.

role_matrix.intent: Restrained app-like brand chrome where product/scope information must remain primary.
role_matrix.identity_relation: C0 + O3 horizontal relationship; brand must recede behind the synthetic scope label.

role_matrix.intent: Website-header relationship with more breathing room than app compact.
role_matrix.identity_relation: C0 and O3 remain distinct jobs inside one header identity group.
C0 precedes O3 vertically; TYP F1 content follows as subordinate information.

mechanical_preflight: All 12 logical surfaces exist in the frozen review order.
Exact C0 and O3 source geometry hashes match the canonical LF asset hashes.
FULL and all diagnostics differ only by their declared ablation/substitution.
TYP F1/CNEG role values equal the frozen TYP-02 vectors and responsive heading values.
MAT F1 and STA F2 values equal their frozen packet/default values.
No horizontal overflow at 1200 or 320 in any browser mode.
200% root text resize preserves all required content without clipping or horizontal scrolling.
Text-spacing stress preserves content and role order.
Forced-colors preserves readable content, a single identity accessible name, focus-visible outline and selected witness; decorative MAT channels may flatten.
No custom/downloaded font, remote resource, raster image, canvas, WebGL, gradient, filter, backdrop-filter, glow, animation, transition, timer or autoplay behavior.
No functional product semantics are encoded by candidate geometry.
subjective_falsification: FAIL if C0 and O3 compete for first read instead of forming a clear mark/name hierarchy appropriate to the role.
FAIL if O3 reads as a second editorial heading rather than the name carrier.
FAIL if TYP-02 F1 becomes more identity-dominant than O3 or makes the name carrier visually redundant.
FAIL APP_COMPACT if branding displaces the synthetic scope label or reads promotional rather than restrained.
FAIL WEB_HEADER if the identity group becomes an over-coupled universal lockup or loses the approved breathing-room distinction.
FAIL ACQUISITION_PRELUDE if mark + name + heading become three simultaneous headline events or if C0 cannot operate as a prelude.
FAIL if O3 compact rendering loses the Æ enough to impair name recognition at the frozen role size.
FAIL if NEUTRAL_TYP is materially stronger because F1 creates avoidable identity competition.
FAIL if NO_O3 is materially stronger because O3 creates avoidable hierarchy collision.
FAIL if O3_SOLO is materially stronger because C0 creates avoidable mark/name competition.
FAIL if the result depends on color, custom typeface, imagery, motion spectacle or product-specific semantics to feel coherent.
review_order: freeze Design Sol view before any Director taste input
director_gate: Only if more than one materially valid hierarchy arrangement exists and the remaining distinction is irreducible taste/product meaning. A simple FULL pass does not create final lockup or Phase-C authority.
construction_freeze: After first specimen materialization, C0/O3 geometry, TYP F1/CNEG values, MAT/STA values, role dimensions, identity measures, content, responsive rules, diagnostic definitions, review order and stress modes may not be retuned. Mechanical repair may only restore this exact frozen contract.
explicit_non_authority: No final logo/wordmark lockup or universal mark/name ratio.
No final wordmark master, final typeface or production typography tokens.
No CLR-01 reentry, palette/material-color selection or Mineral Theater recolor.
No motion scoring/refinement, hero/static artwork, real product UI, functional iconography, app/site implementation, final identity or Phase-C convergence.
